responsibility: Implements the Blackfin backend’s procedural target hooks and code-generation support that complement the declarative patterns in bfin.md. This file owns the port’s C-side ABI and RTL logic for function kind attributes, argument passing and return handling, stack-frame/prologue-epilogue save decisions, PIC/FDPIC address legalization, target-specific costs and address legitimacy, builtin initialization and expansion for Blackfin DSP operations, hardware-loop and scheduling/reorg support, trampoline and thunk emission, register-usage setup, and assembler file/label output hooks; in short, it translates generic GCC RTL expansion, reload, scheduling, and asm-output requests into Blackfin-specific behavior and target hook implementations.
same_name_distinction: This is the Blackfin port’s procedural implementation file: it contains the executable C-side target hook logic and helper routines that realize ABI decisions, PIC/FDPIC address legalization, builtin expansion, prologue/epilogue handling, scheduling/reorg support, and final targetm hook bindings. Unlike bfin.h it does not define the compile-time target macros and declarations, unlike bfin.md it does not express instruction patterns and automata in machine-description form, and unlike bfin.opt it does not declare the generated option table or target option variables.
